responseBody.title: CKYC Sponsor Response Files

skipped.what: Files dated 27-Jul onward parse under the previous field map
skipped.why: The sponsor changed the response-file layout on 27-Jul without a version bump. The files are ingested but their fields are mapped to the rev 2 order, so field-level citations after 27-Jul are unreliable until the adapter is re-mapped.

responseBody.note: This is the source of the INC-2261 mismatch, and the reason the diagnosis is stated as grounded rather than certain.
